**Media-type pin:** `[205, 204, 1]` → `[213, 212, 1]`, 8 more JSON bodies. `submitBenefitMeasurement` has no body. No other pinned count changed.

**What was built:**
- **API:** plan and forecast values, and the seven value states kept apart. Measurements are calculated on the formula engine, which I didn't change, with full lineage. Submitting puts a value in the Finance queue. The Finance decision is FIN only and checks all six items; the submitter can't approve their own value, and a provisional basis is refused. Validated values are corrected only by linked amendment and reversal rows. Totals count each benefit once, using decimal arithmetic.
- **Worker:** exactly one Finance queue item per submitted measurement, even when the event is replayed or the worker restarts. After an accepted KPI actual, a linked benefit gets one pending value, and the validated total doesn't change.
- **Tests:** every one of the 14 requirement rows has a test against its acceptance text.

**Failures during the work (all fixed before the evidence run):**
- **Two repo guard tests failed on my code:** comments spelled out the lock number, and some code used computed property keys. Both fixed.
- **Queue paging repeated rows:** the cursor kept only milliseconds while the database stores microseconds. Fixed.
- **Overlapping runs:** my `pkill` didn't stop an earlier check run, so two runs overlapped and wrote into the same logs. I threw those results away.
- **Worker test failure in the full suite:** the second run failed one worker test because older events nothing consumes yet block the relay in the shared database. The test now keeps relaying until its own event goes out.
- **Clean final run:** I deleted all logs and ran everything once more, sequentially.

**Decisions for you:**
- **Two edits outside my file list.** One import and four lines in `packages/shared/src/schemas/events.ts` to register my four outbox events, because unregistered events are refused. One assertion in KBE-C's `kpi-p4/actuals.test.ts`, `"unknown"` → `"not_applicable"`, because registering my downstream provider (my §B.3 duty) changes that value.
- **`benefit.variance_evaluated` has no queue yet.** BE-D needs to map it in `queues/raid.ts`. Until then the relay logs a failure for each of these events; they aren't dropped.
- **FE-A/FE-C need i18n keys** for the ADR-0030 §11 codes, two plan-value codes, the Finance task message and the KPI downstream benefit label.
- **Design choices to review:**
  - Pending values are created only from runs triggered by an accepted actual.
  - Gross totals leave out non-financial benefits valued through an approved method.
  - Portfolio totals need `organization.read`.

No migration is needed. Nothing granted a real business, Finance or IT approval, and all data is synthetic.
